title: Drag the King to f8
setup: Your rook already sits on the back rank, and Black's king has no air at all behind its pawns.
hint: The king is safe on g8 and lost on f8. What can you give away to make it step across?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxf8+}} has one legal answer: {{Kxf8}}. The king now stands on the open eighth rank with its own pawns walling it in, and {{Qd8#}} finishes. Lure first, mate second. A king that is safe on one square is often lost on the very next one.
